entities.name: Ragnar
entities.description: A gifted healer from Kusho who used green mana healing and worshipped Gaea.

entities.name: Gosta Dirk
entities.description: Leader of the tribe Ragnar belonged to, whom Ragnar resembles.

entities.name: Barktooth Warbeard
entities.description: Persona of Halfdane, who posed as the Marshal.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: Changeling posing as Barktooth Warbeard who killed Ragnar.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Captors who took Ragnar during their campaign on the island.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Used 'By Ragnar's beard!' as an expression in 3335 AR.

events.summary: Ragnar, as part of Gosta Dirk's tribe, is captured by the kentsu during their campaign on the island and put into Barktooth Warbeard's care.
events.quote: he was captured by the kentsu during their campaign on the island

events.summary: Left alone with Ragnar, Halfdane kills him, takes his head, gazes into it for hours and throws it off a cliff.
events.quote: he killed him and took his head

relations.note: Killed him and took his head.
